svg.text: Transmission polariscope: motorized linear analyzer + USB image capture + optional measured load
DESIGN PROPOSAL — not bench-tested. This sheet is the wiring basis; hardware firmware, calibration and experimental validation remain to be completed.
PS1: isolated, regulated 12 V DC / 3 A adapter
Use an enclosed certified adapter; no mains wiring on this board.
Motor and LED return directly to the supply ground.
Uno is powered only by laptop USB; leave Vin/barrel unused.
Never connect +12_SW to Uno 5V, USB, or an I/O pin.
The camera sends images to the laptop, not to Arduino GPIO.
Two USB ports or a powered USB hub
Lock settings for an angle sweep.
Capture protocol: command angle → wait for DONE → settle →
discard buffered frames → capture → save angle + measured force.
Start with 300–500 ms settling; verify it on the assembled hardware.
C | ARDUINO UNO R3 (5 V LOGIC)
Read signal names, not a clone board’s physical orientation.
D0 / D1: reserve for USB serial
Boot: EN HIGH (disabled), STEP LOW, LED_CTL LOW.
STEP high/low ≥5 µs; wait ≥1 ms after driver wake-up.
Repeated net labels are electrically connected.
D | MOTORIZED ANALYZER: A4988 + BIPOLAR STEPPER
Find coil pairs with an ohmmeter.
Motor stays outside the light path.
P2 rotates on its own bearing.
E | LED BACKLIGHT: DC ON/OFF, NOT PWM DURING CAPTURE
LED_CTL HIGH = ON. Use a current-limited panel; never connect a bare power LED here.
F | HOME / INDEX SWITCH FOR P2
Away = LOW; index/open wire = HIGH. Verify LOW on back-off; debounce + timeout.
G | OPTIONAL FORCE MEASUREMENT (NOT MOTOR LOADING)
Match cell datasheet (not colors). Tare + calibrate in newtons. Channel B unused.
H | SET CURRENT BEFORE RUNNING THE MOTOR
Start I_TRIP = 0.60 A/phase; never exceed the motor rating.
Read actual sense resistors; clone carriers may use other values.
C1 polarity: + to VMOT, − to GND; mount close to the driver.
Fit a heatsink and check temperature; keep power returns short.
POWER OFF before connecting or disconnecting motor leads.
Optical arrows indicate the light path, not electrical wiring. The specimen is loaded by a separate manual fixture.
LC1 in series if force is recorded
Use LINEAR polarizers, not photographic circular/CPL filters. At 0°, P2 is parallel to P1; at 90°, crossed. Home SW2, then calibrate optical zero.
J | BUILD NOTES + CORRECTIONS TO THE PROJECT CLAIMS
Common GND everywhere; +5_LOGIC is Uno USB 5 V.
Use terminal wiring for motor/LED power.
Identify coils, set VREF, then home and verify direction.
0.028125°/pulse is a command increment, not accuracy.
Warm up the light; lock exposure, gain and white balance.
Record dark/flat references and angle-tagged images.
Measure thickness and stress-optic coefficient C.
Use a rated fixture; 1000 N in simulation is not a load command.
Initial output: qualitative polarization / stress-pattern images.
White LED + RGB camera ≠ three monochromatic channels.
CNN defect labels and pass/fail need labelled physical tests.
The current simulation is not a validated physical digital twin.
NET LEGEND: +12_SW (red) · +5_LOGIC (purple) · signals (teal) · GND (gray). Repeated labels connect; a dot marks a junction. Module pins are functional labels, not a PCB footprint.
